 GlobalSafe brings "Made in Vietnam" fire alarm monitoring technology to the international market.
 GlobalSafe has signed an exclusive distribution agreement with King Fire (Singapore), bringing its remote fire alarm monitoring solution developed by a Vietnamese company to the international market, marking the beginning of its expansion strategy in Southeast Asia.
 Người Đưa Tin • 29/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 On October 28, 2026, GlobalSafe International Technology and Trade Joint Stock Company (GlobalSafe) signed an exclusive distribution cooperation agreement with King Fire Pte. Ltd., a fire protection and prevention company based in Singapore . 
 According to the agreement, King Fire will distribute GlobalSafe-branded remote fire alarm monitoring equipment and platforms in Singapore, before gradually expanding to other Southeast Asian markets. This is a step to bring a technology product developed and manufactured by a Vietnamese company to the international market under its own brand, rather than being a subcontractor for another brand. 
 Mastering remote fire alarm monitoring technology. 
 In building management and operation, many current fire alarm systems still operate independently, with warning signals primarily displayed at a central control panel located within the building or factory. This necessitates enhanced remote monitoring capabilities, especially for businesses, investors, and management units overseeing multiple projects in different locations. 
 Driven by this need, GlobalSafe has developed a remote fire alarm monitoring solution based on Internet of Things (IoT) and cloud computing technology. The system includes GS6 and GS9 central gateway devices, wireless peripherals, and a centralized management software platform. 
 By connecting with the existing fire alarm system, the solution allows for the collection and transmission of data to a monitoring platform, displaying device status, identifying alarm locations on the building's floor plan, and sending information to the responsible person. This enables the management unit to remotely monitor the system status and receive incident information, supporting timely inspection, verification, and handling. 
 The solution is designed as an additional layer of monitoring, not a replacement for the certified fire alarm system already installed in the building. 
 One of the key features that GlobalSafe focuses on is compatibility with fire alarm systems from multiple manufacturers. Currently, the platform supports connections with fire alarm control panels from many international brands such as Notifier by Honeywell, Siemens, Hochiki, Advanced, Cooper, GST, Edwards, and Securifire. 
 This integration capability is significant in market expansion, as buildings in each country may use different fire alarm systems. Instead of requiring the replacement of all existing equipment, the solution aims to leverage existing infrastructure and add centralized monitoring capabilities. 
 GlobalSafe states that the company is now proactively developing core technology components, including hardware design, embedded software (firmware), cloud computing platforms, communication protocols, and controllers connected to fire alarm panels. Mastering this technology allows the company to tailor products, develop additional features, and integrate new device lines to meet the specific requirements of each market. 
 Singapore – the first market in our international expansion strategy. 
 You may also like Choosing Singapore as its first destination marks GlobalSafe's shift from developing products domestically to approaching international markets. 
 Singapore is a market with high demands for construction safety, technical standards, and service quality. Therefore, GlobalSafe identified the product deployment there as an opportunity to assess the adaptability of the solution to the technical and operational requirements of a foreign market. 
 In this strategy, King Fire acts as a distribution partner and provides deployment support in the local market. With its operations in the fire protection sector, product ecosystem, and distribution network in Southeast Asia, King Fire is expected to support GlobalSafe in reaching customers, implementing projects, and developing the market. 
 According to the cooperation agreement, King Fire will have exclusive distribution rights for GlobalSafe products in the markets agreed upon by both parties, starting with Singapore. Countries such as Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines , and Thailand are included in the next expansion plan, based on specific agreements between the two companies. The Vietnamese market will continue to be managed by GlobalSafe and its domestic distribution network. 
 In addition to equipment distribution, the two parties will collaborate on providing cloud-based monitoring services, technical training, and customer support during operation. King Fire will handle initial support in international markets, while GlobalSafe's engineering team will be responsible for addressing in-depth technical issues. 
 Notably, the products continue to be offered under the GlobalSafe brand. This is a consistent strategy of the company in building a Vietnamese technology brand in the international market, while maintaining its research, development, and product upgrading capabilities in Vietnam. 
 Mr. Nguyen Thanh Tung, Director of GlobalSafe, shared: "We want to prove that Vietnamese businesses are capable of mastering core technologies, from equipment design to software platform development, and bringing products to the international market under our own brand. Collaborating with King Fire is the first step in our expansion strategy in Southeast Asia, and also creates opportunities for GlobalSafe to further refine its products to meet the requirements of different markets." 
 On behalf of the partner, Mr. Ong I-Ping Kelvyn, representing King Fire, stated: "GlobalSafe's solution offers the ability to remotely monitor fire alarm systems and connect with a wide range of devices. We expect this collaboration to add more technological options for our customers and lay the foundation for a long-term partnership between the two parties." 
 Opening up more opportunities for Vietnamese technology in the regional market. 
 In the context of digital transformation being increasingly applied to building management and operation, solutions for connecting and monitoring equipment remotely are opening up new avenues for development in the field of fire safety. 
 For GlobalSafe, the partnership with King Fire is not only about expanding distribution channels but also an opportunity to test the international commercialization potential of products developed by Vietnamese businesses. Directly supplying both equipment and software platforms also helps the company maintain the ability to upgrade technology, provide technical support, and develop services in the long term. 
 In the initial phase, GlobalSafe and King Fire plan to implement pilot projects in Singapore, while simultaneously refining training programs, technical documentation, and customer support procedures. The two parties will also assess the feasibility of integrating additional fire alarm control panel lines, and prepare information security and data infrastructure requirements tailored to each market. 
 You may also like Based on the results of the implementation in Singapore, GlobalSafe will continue to collaborate with King Fire to explore opportunities for expansion to other countries in the region. 
 From a solution developed to meet fire alarm monitoring needs in Vietnam, GlobalSafe is gradually approaching the international market with a model combining equipment, software platforms, and technical services. This direction also demonstrates the potential for Vietnamese technology companies to participate in the global market by both providing products and directly mastering the technology and developing their brands. 
 About GlobalSafe 
 GlobalSafe International Technology and Trading Joint Stock Company, headquartered in Hanoi , develops and provides remote fire alarm monitoring solutions including GS6 and GS9 gateways, wireless peripherals, and a cloud platform. The company owns the hardware, firmware, and platform software. 
 About King Fire 
 King Fire Pte. Ltd. is a fire protection company based in Singapore, with a fire alarm control panel ecosystem and distribution channels across Southeast Asia.
